title: erechtites hieraciifolius var. cacalioides
intro: Erechtites hieraciifolius var. cacalioides, commonly known as St. Johnswort, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to the Americas. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and depression, due to its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of St. Johnswort include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve mood, while its therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of St. Johnswort include hyperforin and hypericin, which are responsible for its medicinal effects, as well as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
